decisions.statement: The interpreter is the `lua5.1` binary on the path rather than a binary bundled here.
One subprocess answers many scripts in turn.
A value crosses back from Lua as JSON.
A value crosses into Lua as a Lua literal written out here.
The Lua the subprocess loads first is a file beside a page rather than a string.
Nothing here compiles TypeScript to Lua.

definition: a Lua 5.1 interpreter kept alive in a subprocess and talked to over a pipe
